Messages: Heavy fighting reported around Central Pump Station, Northern Dam, Northern Town, Southern Barracks. Keep off the approaches.
Spotters report The Jackal Cohort (convoy) moving from North Highway Pileup toward Western Town.
Active barter posts: Frontier Exchange at Settler Haven; UN Quartermaster at Eastern Airfield; Rust Syndicate Water Broker at Hilltop Water Station.
[TF BLUE SHIELD] Green Zone status operational. Blue Helmets authorized for triage at Eastern Airfield.
[SYNDICATE NET] Hilltop Water Station pressure nominal. Unauthorized siphon attempts will draw lethal fire.
[JACKAL CB INTERCEPT] Heavy trucks spotted on the northern bitumen. Keep the heavy iron hot.
[KARKAS BEACON] High ridges are closed to outsiders. Turn back or draw fire from the heights.
